summary: Magnachip Semiconductor Corp files a 424B5 prospectus supplement registering an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $50 million of common stock, with B. Riley Securities as sales agent. Shares trade on NYSE under MX; last sale $5.50 per share on June 16, 2026. The sales agent receives a commission of up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. No fixed price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is involved. This is a routine shelf takedown for capital raising, not a special situation. What to watch: pace of sales and dilution impact.
